pages.text: The snowy plains are a place where life is buried, where the cold gnaws at the bones. Since the ancient days when the illagers were exiled, countless figures have been left forever in this desolate wasteland. To conquer the snowy plains and to protect their kin, the first ones to don blue robes stepped forward.

With their flesh and blood they resisted the biting wind, facing the heavens and earth in their frail forms, hoping only that their people might safely cross that land of death. This was the origin of the iceologers.

Illagers are never content with mere survival. Even after crossing the snowy plains, even after settling in habitable lands, the call of their homeland never ceased. Thus, more of their kin with magical aptitude volunteered to don the blue robes and return to that snowy plain called death.

They only hoped that the journey back would not be as arduous as their exodus. This goal was as remote as a fantasy; they might never see the light of dawn in their lifetimes. Yet all the iceologers still exhausted themselves, striving only to return to their distant homeland one day sooner. They believed that man can triumph over nature, unaware that this path might have no end in sight.

Until one day, that peerlessly talented iceologer finally glimpsed the sole answer. If they willingly turned themselves into the snow and wind, they could coalesce into a relic that commands the blizzard. One day, this relic would grip the throat of the snowy plains, bringing dawn to the road home. The price was their lives. All of them went to their deaths, except that genius was left behind.

Not because he feared death, but because his comrades entrusted him with their final words: You must witness all this, guard the Heart of Silent Frost that we have become, ensure that the howling snowy plains claim no more souls, lead us home, and make sure that all of us are remembered
From then on, there were no more iceologers in the world. Instead, there were only weepologers. They weep in reverence for nature and in mourning for their forebears.
The ice hermit is that very genius. He has guarded that heart for hundreds of years. Now, it is finally ready to mature. It is time.
